root_cause: Authorized workers could stop at green PR/CI instead of owning protected promotion through production readback and learning writeback.

moving_main_recovery.operation: merge default branch into candidate branch via GitHub merge endpoint

premature_close_recovery.evidence: PR #2063 closed twice without merge while exact-head gates were active; GitHub issue events recorded the close under the repository user identity.
premature_close_recovery.automatic_recovery: pull_request.closed guard reopens only unmerged PRs carrying the canonical TERMINAL_DELIVERY lease
premature_close_recovery.intentional_cancel: set Writer-Lease-State to RELEASED or CANCELLED before closing

incident_findings: A new terminal-writer-lease regression test was added without classifier co-change, causing BRAIN plan and Required preflight to fail on an otherwise valid candidate.
Parallel workers independently allocated the same Supabase migration timestamp, producing a global uniqueness failure despite locally valid work.
Head-age based stale detection could cancel healthy in-progress exact-head work and amplify queue thrash.
Historical cancelled Required/BRAIN attempts on one SHA could incorrectly dominate newer healthy retries.
Multiple writers mutated one terminal branch while exact-head gates were running, repeatedly superseding valid evidence.
PR open/closed metadata changed independently from the canonical obligation and branch/head state.
Main moved repeatedly during terminal delivery; rebuilding on every non-overlapping move created avoidable churn.
A merge-tree built from only the latest main commit can omit earlier current-main changes; full merge-base union is required.
A new executable regression test was added without classifier co-change, causing deterministic BRAIN/Required failure.
PR #2063 was merged while candidate Required was still finishing, so post-merge readback and main gates were required to prove safety and exposed a merge-protection gap.
prevention: CLASSIFIER_COCHANGE_REQUIRED: every new executable regression path must be assigned to an existing delivery lane in the same candidate before expensive CI.
PARALLEL_SPECIALISTS_SINGLE_ROLLING_INTEGRATOR: parallelize independent work and serialize only overlapping integration boundaries.
ONE_ACTIVE_WRITER_LEASE_PER_OBLIGATION: bind an immutable exact head during terminal delivery and defer non-owner writes.
PROGRESS_AWARE_RECOVERY: never cancel healthy current-head in-progress work solely because the branch or PR is old.
LATEST_CRITICAL_ATTEMPT_WINS: for one exact head, newest Required and newest BRAIN attempts are authoritative; older cancellations remain audit only.
OPTIONAL_QUEUE_NOISE_CANNOT_REDISPATCH_CRITICAL_GATES: unrelated queued workflows do not retrigger Required/BRAIN.
CLASSIFIER_COCHANGE_REQUIRED: every executable regression path must be classified in the same candidate before expensive CI.
FULL_CURRENT_MAIN_UNION_FROM_MERGE_BASE: rolling integration preserves all current-main changes, never latest-commit-only overlays.
MIGRATION_VERSION_ALLOCATION_AT_INTEGRATION: final Supabase migration versions are allocated by the rolling integrator and checked for uniqueness before CI.
NON_OVERLAPPING_MAIN_DRIFT_DOES_NOT_FORCE_REBUILD: if mergeable and contract/path overlap is absent, keep the tested candidate.
OBLIGATION_BRANCH_HEAD_IS_AUTHORITY: PR number is transport metadata; recovery follows obligation plus canonical branch and exact head.
NO_DUPLICATE_SAME_OBLIGATION_RECOVERY_LINEAGE: queued, cancelled or stale metadata is repaired on the canonical lineage first.
MERGE_REQUIRES_TERMINAL_REQUIRED_AND_BRAIN: future protected promotion must not occur until the intended exact-head release gates are terminal green.
